notes: §2002:14.8.26.3 GR24: an OPEN of a file connector a previously-executed CLOSE WITH LOCK locked is unsuccessful with status 38. From 2002 FileRegistry.CloseWithLock locks the connector (its name, _locked; DialectBehavior.CloseWithLockLocksFileConnector) and SharedOpenAttempt answers 38 for it alone: after CLOSE S1 WITH LOCK an OPEN of S1 is 38 while a second SELECT of the same physical file opens it (00) and reads its record; at --std 85 the physical file is locked instead (kb/Work PB5210, §1985:II.2).
